test_cases.text: Victim was duped in Telegram job scam by @earn_daily_bot. Transferred Rs 45000 to UPI pay.mule01@okhdfcbank after calling +91-98210-11223.
YouTube like task prepaid scheme via Telegram @earn_daily_bot. Sent Rs 80000 to UPI pay.mule01@okhdfcbank. Contact phone +91-98210-11223.
Rating task scam coordinator calling from mobile +91-98210-11223 demanded recharge fee to account 981273910293 with IFSC HDFC0001928.
Electricity bill disconnection alert SMS. Pay bill at https://power-discom-billpay.in or call nodal helpline +91-94250-99881. Support email support@power-discom-billpay.in.
Power cut warning message directed victim to portal https://power-discom-billpay.in and made victim deposit money to account 5010091823901.
Phishing caller on +91-94250-99881 asked victim to download QuickSupport APK for electricity meter update. Defrauded of Rs 92000.
Victim blackmailed by loan app recovery agent calling from +91-98710-44556. Threatening WhatsApp messages and morphed photos sent. Paid to UPI loan.payback@paytm.
Instant loan app harassment with contact list circulation threats from phone +91-98710-44556. Demanded payment to mule UPI loan.payback@paytm.
Digital arrest scam where fake CBI officer on Skype called from +91-97110-33221 claiming parcel with contraband drugs. Escrow transfer to UPI safe.escrow@ybl.
Fake police officer Skype interrogation. Caller +91-97110-33221 coerced victim into depositing Rs 350000 into account 40192839102 IFSC SBIN0001029.
Prepaid Telegram task fraud managed by @speedy_crypto_tasks. Complainant transferred Rs 120000 to UPI merchant.trust@icici.
Fake hotel review task on Telegram @speedy_crypto_tasks. Payouts stopped after victim paid Rs 200000 to beneficiary A/C 91029384756 IFSC ICIC0000192.
Bank KYC update SMS with link https://sbi-netbanking-verify.in. Received call from +91-93110-88776 demanding OTP.
Phishing site sbi-netbanking-verify.in accessed by victim. Debit card credentials harvested and unauthorized payment sent to UPI gate.collect@axl.
Crypto trading investment group on WhatsApp promised 500 percent return. Transferred 1.5 ETH to wallet 0x71C8293810293810293810293810293810293849. Contact email broker@alpha-fx-returns.com.
Forex trading platform investment scam. Demanded withdrawal fee to crypto address 0x71C8293810293810293810293810293810293849. Contact phone +91-99881-22334.
Digital arrest intimidation call by suspect claiming Mumbai Police Cyber Cell on +91-97270-33418. Video call on Skype.
Fake customs parcel extortion call from +91-97270-33418. Demanded transfer to escrow UPI extort.release99@paytm.
Prepaid job task commission fraud. Complainant transferred Rs 55000 to UPI taskpay.merchant88@okhdfcbank via contact phone +91-98201-44719.
YouTube subscriber booster task coordinator mobile +91-98201-44719 asked for funds to UPI taskpay.merchant88@okhdfcbank.
Electricity disconnection phishing alert from +91-94150-88219 leading to secure-billpay-update.in. Paid via UPI quickpay.energy@axl.
Fake bill payment notification from alerts@secure-billpay-update.in for power bill. Victim transferred to account 5010049281729 IFSC HDFC0001829.
Instant loan app blackmail from WhatsApp number +91-98930-11204 threatening contact list leak. Coerced into UPI payment extort.release99@paytm.
Threatening recovery calls from +91-98930-11204 for online loan. Victim transferred Rs 120000 to UPI loan.recovery.safe@ybl.
Prepaid hotel rating task scam on Telegram @fast_payouts_in with payment sent to UPI taskpay.merchant88@okhdfcbank.
